\title{A Faster Widget Network}
\author{A. Author}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We propose WidgetNet. On the ImageNet-1K benchmark, WidgetNet reaches a top-1 accuracy of 81.2\% while being 2.0 times faster than ResNet-50.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
Widgets are everywhere. We show in Section~\ref{sec:results} that WidgetNet is fast.

\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
Each block maps inputs of dimension $d_{in}$ to outputs of the same size, following \cite{he2016}.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:block}
y = \sigma(W x + b)
\end{equation}
Equation~\eqref{eq:block} is applied $L$ times, where $d_{in}$ stays fixed.

\section{Results}\label{sec:results}
Table~\ref{tab:main} compares WidgetNet with baselines built from the block of Section~\ref{sec:method}, with inputs of size $d_{in}$.
On the ImageNet-1K benchmark, WidgetNet reaches a top-1 accuracy of $80.4\%$, and it runs 2.0 times faster than ResNet-50 (Figure~1).

\begin{table}
\caption{Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.}\label{tab:main}
\begin{tabular}{lc}
Model & Top-1 \\
ResNet-50 & 76.1 \\
WidgetNet & 80.4 \\
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\begin{figure}
\caption{Throughput comparison.}\label{fig:speed}
\end{figure}

\section{Conclusion}
WidgetNet is accurate and fast.
